Sponsor: ID-Cooling Frozn A620 SLK on Amazon https://geni.us/Vc8Zi
The first Thermalright case we're reviewing isn't bad, but it's not good either. The case falls short of impressing with Thermalright's usual aggressive pricing and high performance. The A70 doesn't innovate in any particular category, which could be fine if the price is low enough, but it's priced like cases that did innovate. We had one manufacturing defect on one unit, fingerprints and air bubbles underneath adhesives for the corner pyramid, and noticed design oversights with drive cages, the motherboard tray, and elsewhere in the case.
